description: Simulated app event. The simulated trip-planner app generates a day-by-day itinerary for a trip.

event_id.description: Producer-assigned unique id. When present and non-empty it is the dedup key.

latency_ms.description: Time taken to generate the itinerary, in milliseconds.

occurred_at.description: When the action happened on the client, RFC 3339 with offset.

received_at.description: When the collector received the event (used to spot late arrivals).

session_id.description: App session the event belongs to.

simulated.description: Always true - every event in this catalog is simulated.

user_id.description: Pseudonymous app user id (not an email).

title: itinerary_generated v1
